lines: When power-descent comes near the hour of death —
of himself, or through a kinsman's mouth —
then for him the exit-initiation: let it be done at once.
sanskrit_cite: yadā punar āsannamaraṇasya svayaṃ vā bandhumukhena śaktipāta upajāyate tadā asmai sadyaḥ samutkramaṇadīkṣāṃ kuryāt

lines: The whole path placed in the disciple, purified in order,
blessed Kālarātrī the vein-cutter set by her, joint by joint —
vein-nooses split, the disciple's consciousness
is made to dwell at the brahmarandhra.
sanskrit_cite: samastam adhvānaṃ śiṣye nyasya taṃ ca krameṇa śodhayitvā bhagavatīṃ kālarātrīm marmakartanīṃ nyasya tayā kramāt kramaṃ marmapāśān vibhidya brahmarandhravarti śiṣyacaitanyaṃ kuryāt

lines: Then, by the aforesaid order, the full-offering
is given for yojanā's sake — so that, at the offering,
the departed soul goes out and becomes one with Paramaśiva.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ pūrvoktakrameṇa yojanikārthaṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt yathā pūrṇāhutyante jīvo niṣkrāntaḥ paramaśivābhinno bhavati

lines: The desirer of enjoyment gets
the second full-offering.
In the enjoyment-place, for yojanā, at that time
in his jīvalaya — no remaining-turning stands;
or Brahma-vidyā recited in the ear —
of parāmarśa-nature — instantly awakens vimarśa
in the consciousness of the already-awakened paśu.
sanskrit_cite: bhogasthāne yojanāya tatkāle ca tasya jīvalayaḥ nātra śeṣavartanam brahmavidyāṃ vā karṇe paṭhet sā hi parāmarśasvabhāvā sadyaḥ prabuddhapaśucaitanye prabuddhavimarśaṃ karoti

lines: Also in this recitation stands authority
from samayya and the rest.
With-conviction, seedless initiation — shown to the fool
and to the late-comer, whose power-descent has come:
at Śiva-hand-giving-time this rite —
a triangular āgneya mandala, flame-terrible, repha-spark,
outward-vāta-wheel-rolling, contemplated in the right hand,
a little seed cast therein — by up-down repha-revealed
phaṭkāra-successions her generative-power is burnt.
Doing thus, the hand is cast onto the disciple's head:
for both, this seedless initiation destroys the capacity
for doing one's own work — since even inanimate things
are stated initiatable. The disciple is contemplated
installed inside the vāyupura, shaken, become-light —
by which, by comparison, he is seen light.
sanskrit_cite: sapratyayāṃ nirbījāṃ tu yadi dīkṣāṃ mūḍhāya āyātaśaktipātāya ca darśayet tadā hi śivahastadānakāle ayaṃ vidhiḥ trikoṇam āgneyaṃ jvālākarālaṃ rephavisphuliṅgaṃ bahirvātyācakradhyāyamānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dakṣiṇahaste cintayitvā tatraiva haste bījaṃ kiṃcit nikṣipya ūrdhvādhorephavibodhitaphaṭkāraparamparābhiḥ asya tāṃ jananaśaktiṃ dahet evaṃ kurvan taṃ hastaṃ śiṣyasya mūrdhani kṣipet iti dvayor api eṣā dīkṣā nirbījā svakāryakaraṇasāmarthyavidhvaṃsinī bhavati sthāvarāṇām api dīkṣyatvena uktatvāt vāyupurāntarvyavasthitaṃ dodhūyamānaṃ śiṣyaṃ laghūbhūtaṃ cintayet yena tulayā laghuḥ dṛśyate iti
notes: 'jānan' vs 'janana' in jananaśakti kept as printed (generative-power)
